Question: In \(\triangle ABC\) we have \(AB = 7,\) \(AC = 8,\) and \(BC = 9.\) Point \(D\) is on the circumscribed circle of the triangle so that \(\overline{AD}\) bisects \(\angle BAC.\) What is the value of \(\frac{AD}{CD}?\)
